name: Dill

companions.note: Both attract beneficial insects; dill draws swallowtail larvae and parasitic wasps

pnw_notes: Direct sow every 2–3 weeks from April through July for continuous harvest. Self-seeds aggressively — let a few plants go to seed and you may never need to replant. Umbel flowers attract swallowtail larvae and beneficial wasps.

planting_windows.notes: Succession sow every 2–3 weeks; dislikes transplanting
Harvest fronds before flowering for best flavor; collect seed heads when tan and dry
